name: TipoHiZ
description: A typing website made for everyone

paragraphs: Tipohiz is a sleek and customizable typing test platform designed to enhance your typing skills. Our user-friendly interface offers a variety of test modes to challenge typists of all levels. Whether you're a beginner looking to boost your typing speed or a seasoned typist aiming to break your personal record, Tipohiz offers the tools and features you need to succeed. Start your typing journey with Tipohiz today and watch your skills soar!
features: live errors, wpm, and accuracy displays
punctuation and numbers modes (default \| punctuation \| numbers)
timed tests: 15 / 30 / 60 / 120 seconds (palette category: words is label-only — it does not switch to a word-count test)
typing languages: English, Spanish, French (home-page Globe; word lists in modules/TextFiles/)
results after the timer hits the 1s bound: /results with gross WPM, adjusted WPM, accuracy (lib/utils.ts)

proxy.ts redirects a signed-in visitor away from /login and /register.
